queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
  AVG(avg_rate_to_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
  AVG(avg_rate_to_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
  AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length
FROM rating_averages

SELECT AVG((avg_rental_rate / avg_replacement_cost + avg_duration) / 2.0)
FROM (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)

SELECT AVG((avg_rental_rate / avg_replacement_cost + avg_duration) / 2.0)
FROM (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
